resources.string: In Brise on your PC, open Settings > Connection, then copy the connection address and paste it here, or scan the QR code shown there.
The address must start with http:// or https://.
Could not find a host in the address.
The address has no token (?token=…). Paste the address from Settings > Connection as it is.
Connected — Brise on your PC responded.
Authentication failed — the token does not match. Copy the connection address from your PC again.
Unreachable — check that Brise is running on your PC and that Tailscale is connected on this device.
%1$s is outside the Tailscale (100.64.0.0/10) and localhost ranges. Make sure it is the address of a PC you trust. Continue?
The QR scanner could not be opened.
This QR code is not a Brise connection address.
Check that Brise is running on your PC and that Tailscale is connected.
Tailscale looks off. Turn it on, then come back — Brise reconnects automatically.
To use this feature, allow the %1$s permission in Android settings.
